snippet.title: Zelda's Adventure Remastered - Showcase (Demo v0.0.5)
snippet.description:
Welcome to this playthrough of the first demo of my fan remaster of Zelda's Adventure, originally released for the Philips CD-i!
Years ago I fell in love with the quirky game and inspired by the first two Zelda CD-i fan remasters, I started working on remastering the third game myself!
The demo, which can be completed until the end of the Shrine of Earth, can be downloaded here: https://jappawakka.itch.io/zeldas-adventure-remastered
Keep an eye on the page, I might post updates from time to time that include bugfixes and hopefully eventually more content!
